concerns.text: FR-003 uses a placeholder '[deferred]' for the fraction of trajectory time to discard before fitting. Without a concrete value or a deterministic method to compute it, the fitting window cannot be instantiated, making the requirement untestable.

FR-006 also contains a '[deferred]' placeholder for the amount by which to reduce system size if a simulation exceeds 12 h. The lack of a specific reduction rule prevents verification that the fallback behavior complies with the requirement.
